data.text: Kate and Jack, I’m with you: 10 tons each, with a firm 50-ton limit for the group. Luke, I won’t ask the others to race you to an empty lake. My family made a living here, and I want all five of us to keep earning—not just this month. But we need more than promises afterward. Before we launch, let’s agree to track our catches together and stop at our individual shares. Will you withdraw your 100-ton demand and join that arrangement? Emma, we haven’t heard from you—what do you think?
